title: List specific hardware components by class
summary: Filter lshw output to show only specific types of hardware, such as network cards, disks, or processors.

steps.explain: Use the -class flag followed by the hardware category you want to inspect (e.g., network, disk, processor).

placeholders.name: HARDWARE_CLASS
placeholders.description: The type of hardware to list. Common values: system, bridge, memory, processor, storage, disk, network, display, multimedia.

steps.expect: Detailed information about the specified hardware class.
